auth-session-check.why: Refuse the action unless the person has a valid signed-in session, checked on the server.

server-only-secret.why: Keep the API key or secret on the server; it must never reach the browser bundle.

validated-redirect.why: Redirect only to an allow-listed address, so a crafted link cannot send the person elsewhere.

latency-budget.why: Set a response-time budget for this action and check it with a test or a threshold.

owner-only-access.why: Only the owner of the data may read or change it; check ownership on the server.

retry-and-error-state.why: Show an error state and offer a retry when the action fails.

accessibility-check.why: Usable by keyboard and screen reader; run an automated accessibility check.
